name: Convivial Enricher ActiveCampaign
description: Provides integration of Active Campaign API with Enricher.
project_description: Submodule of Convivial Enricher. Provides an 'active_campaign' EnricherDatasource plugin that looks up an ActiveCampaign contact by email hash (the token from the endpoint URL), retrieves the contact's properties, tags and custom field values via ActiveCampaign's REST v3 API (Guzzle, Api-Token header), filters them through shell-wildcard allow-lists, optionally gates the whole enrichment behind an opt-in privacy contact property, and returns the surviving values as cookies. Three API call types (account tags, contact tags, contact) are independently cacheable to respect ActiveCampaign's rate limit.
